ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the
Planned Development 882 symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 2-F in
the area bound by:

West Madison Street; South Dearborn Street; West Monroe Street; and, South
Clark Street

to those of a DC-16, Downtown Core District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

PaN
Patrick Mufphey
Zoning Administrator

Common Address:
10 South Dearborn Street
